text:
jess: Customer reports hitting 403 in console when accessing a project after we linked their Okta org yesterday. They can list orgs but project page is blocked.

leo: Can you paste the project_id and a sample request that fails? Is this the browser console 403 or API?

jess: Browser console error when clicking Projects > AcmeCorp > Environment: "403 Permission denied". API call failing is GET https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/PROJ-8427 returned 403. Customer says they were a Project Admin yesterday.

samir: Looking at SCIM sync logs for that tenant (org_id: ORG-193). I see a group rename event at 2026-03-14T22:08Z: member mapping removed from group "acme-admins" -> now "acme_admins". SCIM delta shows removal + re-add as new group id. Roles tied to group mapping didn't reattach.

maya: @samir so their Okta group rename lost the role binding on our side. Can we resync group->role mapping without forcing a full reprovision? Customer needs immediate access.

samir: We don't have an automatic role-rebind on group rename today. Two options: 1) manual resync API we can run for that org to rebuild members->roles from latest SCIM group links; 2) add user back directly to project as temporary workaround.

jess: Customer user is alice@example.com. They tried re-login and clearing cookies, no change. They can still call some API endpoints (list models) but project-scoped endpoints 403.

infra-oncall: I can run manual resync. Use this internal endpoint (audit-only, safe):
```
POST https://internal-api.redwood.local/v1/orgs/ORG-193/scim/resync
Authorization: Bearer <eng-token>
body: { "dry_run": false }
```
I will run with dry_run=false after approval. This will reapply role bindings from SCIM groups. Expect 30-60s to complete.

jess: Customer approves resync (they're okay with us reapplying mappings). Please run and confirm. @audit-bot please capture audit id.

audit-bot: audit:resync:start org=ORG-193 requested_by=jess at=2026-03-15T00:12:04Z id=AR-9912

infra-oncall: Running now. Progress: fetching SCIM groups -> computing delta -> applying 8 member role updates.

infra-oncall: Done. audit:resync:complete id=AR-9912 status=success applied=8 at=2026-03-15T00:13:27Z

samir: I can confirm user alice@example.com is back in project with role Project Admin. Identity claim check: Okta now sends claim `groups: ["acme_admins"]`. We remapped group name to existing role ID.

jess: Customer reports console access restored, no 403. They said thanks.

leo: For follow-up, let's file an engineering ticket to handle group renames more gracefully (rebind by external group unique id when available, or surface a warning). I'll create a Jira and link audit id AR-9912.

maya: Also propose an automated notification when SCIM deletes+recreates groups in same sync cycle — that will catch renames.

jess: Notes for support thread: repro steps (what customer saw): 1) Okta group rename -> 2) SCIM shows group removal + new group create -> 3) Role bindings lost -> 4) Console 403 on project pages. Temporary fix: internal SCIM resync or add user directly. Long-term: improve rename handling + alerting.

leo: Thanks all. Closing this incident after Jira created. :white_check_mark:
